name: Low back — gentle daily routine
for: A sore or stiff lower back, after the first days have passed
blurb: Movement the back can tolerate, then a little stability. Daily, and gently: nothing here should be pushed into pain.
notes: The cat–camel is motion, not stretch: five to eight easy cycles.
The press-up is for backs that ease with extension — pain moving toward the spine is good, pain moving down the leg is the sign to stop.
The bird dog and the bridge build the stability that keeps it away.

items.note: The leg a little under level; the arm alone is fine on a bad day.
